card.name: Digits inside scripture and year references
card.fires_on: A digit or separator inside a numeric reference such as a Bible verse, chapter:verse number, date range or version number. It is strongest on the first digit of a verse number after a colon.

modes.label: Scripture verse numbers
modes.description: Digit or colon within a chapter:verse citation in religious text.

modes.label: Years and citation numbers
modes.description: Digit in a year range, journal page range or version number.

card.writes: No clear meaning; it only weakly favors odd tokens such as Chinese characters and names, and suppresses the word texture.
card.plain: It fires on the digits inside Bible verse citations and similar number references like years or page ranges.
